webster.text: A disapproving; dislike; the act of the mind which condemns what is supposed to be wrong, whether the act is expressed or not.

example.quote: They must have borne in mind, that as the plan to be framed and proposed was to be submitted TO THE PEOPLE THEMSELVES, the disapprobation of this supreme authority would destroy it forever; its approbation blot out antecedent errors and irregularities.
